cards.card_text: They'll have harps, tambourines, flutes AND lyres out in front, so friend, that's not a walk, that's a parade.
cards.verse_text: As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
cards.snippet: …coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.

cards.card_text: Solomon makes the almug wood into steps for the house of the LORD and the king's palace, and into lyres and harps for the ___.
cards.verse_text: The king made the almug wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.
cards.snippet: …the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.

cards.card_text: David and all the Israelites are celebrating before God with all their might, with songs, harps, lyres, tambourines, cymbals AND trumpets!
cards.verse_text: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
cards.snippet: …before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

cards.card_text: Their job comes with harps, lyres and cymbals.
cards.verse_text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: David has the Levite leaders appoint relatives to serve with harps, lyres and cymbals.
cards.verse_text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: Then comes a long list of names: Heman, Asaph and Ethan on bronze cymbals, others on harps and lyres, priests on trumpets, and guardians for the ark.
cards.verse_text: And Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.
cards.snippet: …Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.

cards.card_text: Rams' horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps and lyres, ALL at once.
cards.verse_text: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
cards.snippet: …horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.

cards.card_text: Asaph, one of the Levite singers (1 Chronicles 15:16-17), is the chief, with a whole crew under him on harps and lyres while he sounds the cymbals.
cards.verse_text: They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
cards.snippet: They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew…

cards.card_text: Prophesy with harps and lyres Guard the gates of the city Keep watch over the treasury
cards.verse_text: Additionally, David and the commanders of the army set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals.
cards.snippet: …sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals.

cards.card_text: The sons play cymbals, harps and lyres under the direction of their fathers.
cards.verse_text: All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God.
cards.snippet: …the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God.

cards.card_text: The Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives, stand on the east side of the altar in fine linen with cymbals, harps and lyres, and 120 priests with trumpets join them.
cards.verse_text: all the Levitical singers—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres, accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.
cards.snippet: …of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres, accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.

cards.card_text: Solomon makes that wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for his palace, and into lyres and harps.
cards.verse_text: The king made the algum wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.
cards.snippet: …the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.

cards.card_text: Who are the lyres and harps for?
cards.verse_text: The king made the algum wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.
cards.snippet: …the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.

cards.card_text: When Jehoshaphat and the men of Judah and Jerusalem get back to Jerusalem, they go into the house of the LORD with harps, lyres and trumpets.
cards.verse_text: So they entered Jerusalem and went into the house of the LORD with harps, lyres, and trumpets.
cards.snippet: …entered Jerusalem and went into the house of the LORD with harps, lyres, and trumpets.

cards.card_text: Then Hezekiah stations the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps and lyres, by the command of David, of Gad the king's seer, and of Nathan the prophet.
cards.verse_text: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet.
cards.snippet: …the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and…

cards.card_text: True or false: David calls on his harp and lyre to wake up.
cards.verse_text: Awake, O harp and lyre!
cards.snippet: Awake, O harp and lyre!

cards.card_text: The writer says he'll praise God with the harp and the lyre.
cards.verse_text: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
cards.snippet: …faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

cards.card_text: And he wants the WHOLE band: a song, the tambourine, the harp and the lyre.
cards.verse_text: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
cards.snippet: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.

cards.card_text: And he wants music behind it: the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
cards.verse_text: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
cards.snippet: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

cards.card_text: Then the psalm brings in the band, starting with the lyre and the harp.
cards.verse_text: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
cards.snippet: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.

cards.card_text: Then David calls out, "Awake, O harp and lyre!
cards.verse_text: Awake, O harp and lyre!
cards.snippet: Awake, O harp and lyre!

cards.card_text: Then the psalm calls in the band: "Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre." Me, I've got one instrument, the oven timer, and it knows exactly ONE song: DING.
cards.verse_text: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
cards.snippet: …with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.

cards.card_text: Their feasts come with lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine.
cards.verse_text: At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine.
cards.snippet: At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine.

cards.card_text: With every stroke of the LORD's rod on Assyria, tambourines and lyres will sound.
cards.verse_text: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.
cards.snippet: …of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.

cards.card_text: Tyre's songs, and the music of her lyres.
cards.verse_text: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.
cards.snippet: …will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.

cards.card_text: With Tyre torn down, God says the songs and lyres of Tyre will be ___.
cards.verse_text: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.
cards.snippet: …will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.

cards.card_text: The herald says that as soon as the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp and pipes play, everyone must do what?
cards.verse_text: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
cards.snippet: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music, you must fall down and…

cards.card_text: Then the band kicks in: horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, all kinds of music.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, as soon as all the people heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, and all kinds of music, the people of every nation and language would fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
cards.snippet: …as all the people heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, and all kinds of music, the people of every nation and…
